svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: macOS · Gallery · item view · a preview · Download the originals? · 1310×800
svg.desc: Mirrors the preview page's just-in-time question in the Mac's Gallery item view (plan §4.2 / §8 / §9; new 2026-09-26): gallery.item.preview.svg with the Light button clicked. A click on any greyed control — one of the six buttons, a locked page of the tab bar, the status card — runs EditorPreviewPage.ask(_:), which reads availability(of: .pixelEdit) and raises the page's .alert in the words of FetchPromptContent (App/FetchPrompt.swift — shared with every other door's .fetchPrompt). For Light (Tapped.group(.light), subject 'Light') on this preview, whose originals PicPlace holds (offer .download): title 'Download \(noun.text)?' → 'Download the originals?'; message '\(subject) needs \(noun.text) — \(shortfall.sizeText) on PicPlace. You can keep browsing while \(noun.pronoun) download.' → 'Light needs the originals — 214 files · 1,16 GB on PicPlace. You can keep browsing while they download.'; 'Download and Continue' → picplace.fetch(capture, shortfall:) (a person's press: any network) and resume = Light — the card turns into progress (gallery.item.preview.downloading.svg) and, when the last file lands with this project still in focus, PhotoViewerView takes the column with the Light panel open; moved on (the filmstrip, ← →), nothing jumps — the project simply has its originals when they come. 'Stay as Is' (role .cancel) changes nothing. THE ALERT IS APPKIT'S (macOS 26) and differs from the iPhone's (iOS/project-photo.viewer.preview.prompt.portrait.svg): measured on three Mac bench captures of 2026-09-25 (a photo's 'Download the full-size photo?', a collection's 'Download this clip?', a project screen's 'The originals aren't here' — the same metrics in each): a 260 pt glass card CENTRED ON THE WINDOW (not dropped from the title bar), radius ≈ 26, no app icon; the text left-aligned 22 pt in and wrapping at 216 pt (the three captures bound it to 213.3–223.2; 22 pt either side of the card is 216) — so this message takes four lines, the last 'download.' alone; the title 13 pt BOLD, its baseline 32.5 under the card's top; the message 13 pt regular on 16 pt lines, in the label colour (not secondary); the two buttons full width, 16 pt in, 28 pt capsules 6 apart on black ~10 % — 'Download and Continue' over 'Stay as Is', both 13 pt REGULAR in the label colour: macOS 26 marks neither as default, so the first is marked by its place, not by the app's tint (the iPhone tints both labels); 16 pt under the last. With a one-line title and four message lines the card is 260 × 204 at (545, 318). The glass is drawn flat (#CDCDCF — what the measured glass gives over this dark poster; the captures' lighter pictures gave 216–225). THE VEIL: the whole window, title bar, filmstrip and tab bar included, goes to 102 + 0.4 × itself (measured: white → 204, #F0F0F5 → 198, black → 102) — a #AAAAAA layer at 60 %, not a black dim. The page under it is gallery.item.preview.svg's, unchanged. OTHER OFFERS (desc-only, the same alert): .downloading — 'Downloading the originals' / '\(n) % so far. Light can go ahead as soon as they are here.' · Continue When Ready · Stay as Is; .signIn — 'Sign in to PicPlace?' · Sign In · Stay as Is; .connect — 'This library isn't connected' · OK; .notUploaded — 'The originals aren't on PicPlace yet' · OK; .unavailable — 'The originals aren't here' / 'Light needs the originals, and they aren't on this Mac or on PicPlace.' · OK. A locked page's subject is 'The Text page' (…'Frames', 'Masks'); the card's, 'Editing'. THE ITEM VIEW is gallery.item.svg's — the inspector column (GalleryPreviewPanel .inspector, 330 pt), the item header (▤ · ‹ Gallery · the name · 'n of N'), the editor column (the media beside the fixed 330 pt rail) and the filmstrip under everything, the floating tab bar — and GalleryItemEditor (App/GalleryItemView.swift) puts EditorPreviewPage in the editor's place when the focus request's asset is `.preview`: GalleryView.enterItem / move(to:) / step stage every project with `stageEditor(for:page:allowsPreview: true)`, so a preview opens, and the filmstrip and ← → walk straight through previews (they stalled on one until 2026-09-25). The page is its own view (EditorPreviewPageContent, plan T6), built from the editor's components with a `locked` state — never the editor mounted on a poster, so it has no write path (no persist net, no white migration, no as-shot reads). SAMPLE: tile 8 of gallery.svg's grid — the interval drawn there with holdings-pill.there.safe (a preview: its originals removed here, PicPlace holds them, the ✓ stays) — 8 of 14, an unnamed shoot, so its displayTitle is the dated 'Stack 7. 9. at 21:40' (the window title and the header both carry it); 214 JPEG originals (3024 × 4032 — INFO's Size), 1,16 GB recorded in assets.ndjson; the grade is a record, so the dots of Presets and Light still show. LAYOUT (App/EditorPreviewPage.swift railBody, the Mac's only dressing): the picture pane — black, the whole 648 × 568 column (no timeline strip, no full-screen button, no marquee badge: the badge is the dark card's) — with poster.jpg as it is (previewPictureURL; graded when it was made, never graded again), scaledToFit and centred: 426 × 568 at x 462; a Divider; the rail, a ScrollView padded 14 / 16 / 20 with 12 between — RailTabBar (App/RailTabBar.swift, locked: Text · Frames · Masks accent at 38 %, Editor selected), EditorGroupBar (.macCard, locked: every cell #6D6D72 at 42 %, none selected, the dots LL.accent at 55 %), then statusCard(style: .light) at y 237 — LL.cardBackground, radius 16, padding 12, no badge. Every greyed control stays clickable and ASKS (a click on a locked page → ask(.tab), a group → ask(.group), the card itself → ask(.line), subject 'Editing'). macOS rounds each Text frame up to the whole point (measured: the stage-1 captures' cards are 57 and 85 pt, exactly the rounded sums), so the rest card is 85 pt where the unrounded arithmetic says 83.7. HOOKS: `LL_DROP_SOURCES=<uuid>` on a Mac scratch root (`-storage.libraryRootPath`) in one launch renders poster.jpg and deletes the originals — with no server the card then reads the `.unavailable` offer ('The originals aren't on this Mac', the slashed camera, no Download) — and `LL_TAB=gallery LL_ITEM=<uuid>` in the next opens the item view on the page; the on-PicPlace reading drawn here needs the PicPlace bench (a bound scratch root, `LL_PICPLACE_TOKENS` always): upload, `LL_PICPLACE_REMOVE=<uuid>:originals`, then `LL_TAB=gallery LL_ITEM=<uuid>`. `LL_PREVIEW_PROMPT=light` raises the prompt 1.2 s after the page appears, `light:download` presses Download and Continue two seconds later; a driver-launched Mac instance is pressed through accessibility, never the pointer — `~/Library/Developer/LetsLapseRun/tools/ax press <pid> '*' AXButton 'Download and Continue'`; `LL_PICPLACE_TRANSFER_OUTAGE=0:20` holds the download long enough to see its progress. Geometry from the code, checked against the Mac Debug captures of 2026-09-25 (a photo preview in this item view — before §16's glyphs and today's copy: its words and glyphs come from the code, its seats from the captures).
